notes.text: Unsurfaced roads added for eight councils: Devon, East Riding of Yorkshire, Lincolnshire, Norfolk, North Yorkshire, Northumberland, Oxfordshire and Surrey.
Ceredigion County Council's live road closures are now on the map.
Wiltshire Council's rights of way closures are now on the map.
Lanes are now checked for changes four times a day, the same as closures.
Byways for fifteen councils now come straight from the councils' own maps, which are often newer than other copies.
Long-standing and seasonal byway orders that councils list on their websites have been added, each one checked by a person.
Closures and orders that councils publish on their own websites are now shown alongside the national records.
New traffic orders now reach the map the same day they are published to the Department for Transport.
Bridleways and restricted byways are no longer on the map, because motor vehicles may not use them. Byways open to all traffic stay.
